why_good: Shows a chapter with a formation year, a named office address and email, and a member list link. Pairs with Sharma Plumbing Works being in Pune. Use as the 'where a chapter update would be linked from' example.

name: KENT RO Systems: KENT AMC, Annual Maintenance Contract
type: Indian manufacturer running a paid annual service plan (real example for 'reminders that bring work back')
why_good: A large Indian water-appliance brand sells the repeat visit as a product: a yearly contract, clear cover (electrical and mechanical parts), clear exclusions (consumables), a renewal rule (renew within a month of expiry) and a service number. It is the manufacturer-scale version of what a plumbing contractor can do with a simple sheet and WhatsApp.

name: Kirloskar Brothers Limited: Services, Installation/Inspection and Annual Maintenance Contract
type: Indian pump manufacturer offering AMC booking online (real example, relevant to pump servicing reminders)
why_good: A pump maker, directly relevant to plumbing contractors, lists only two services: installation or inspection, and an annual maintenance contract. Shows that pump servicing is a recognised recurring product. Clean page, easy to read on a slide.

name: Residenso Solutions LLP, Pune: Society maintenance, Plumbing
type: Pune housing-society maintenance firm (real example for the 12-month calendar and the customer list)
why_good: A Pune firm that sells plumbing, tank cleaning and drainage cleaning to housing societies as scheduled services, with a visible address, phone and email, and social links. Shows the real market Sharma serves and the services that naturally recur (tank cleaning, drainage cleaning before monsoon).

name: Synergy Repairs and Maintenance, Pune: AMC service provider page
type: Small Pune repair firm selling an AMC with a fixed yearly schedule (optional secondary example)
why_good: Plain-language pitch: 'Annual maintenance contracts that keep plumbing, electrical and civil upkeep on a fixed yearly schedule, instead of a call only when something breaks.' That line is the whole session in one sentence. The page uses a cartoon mascot, so prefer quoting the line over showing the full screenshot; if shown, crop to the yellow header band.

name: Google Business Profile Help: Tips to get more reviews
type: Official platform guidance for the 'moment to ask' slide
why_good: Google's own rules for asking: remind customers with a Google link or QR code, reply to every review, never offer incentives for reviews (it is prohibited). Use it to anchor the review-request message and to warn against paying for reviews.

name: Google Business Profile Help: Manage customer reviews
type: Official platform guidance on replying to reviews
why_good: States that a verified business can reply to reviews and that the reviewer is notified. Supports the 'reply to every review' point in the referrals and reviews segment.

name: WhatsApp Help Center: How to use broadcast lists
type: Official platform page for the broadcast list segment
why_good: Explains the two facts the audience needs: recipients must have saved your number, and lists hold up to 256 contacts. Also notes monthly broadcast limits in some countries. Use it to explain why 'saved contacts who asked to hear from you' is the only list worth having.
